BLACK CAT.name: FELINE FURY
BLACK CAT.desc: Swipe forward with razor-sharp claws

BLACK CAT.name: CLAW WHIP
BLACK CAT.desc: Fire out tethered claws and whip them forward in a devastating arc, dealing damage to all enemies caught in range

BLACK CAT.name: FORTUNE'S FAVOR
BLACK CAT.desc: Spend Fortuneto unleash either Grapple Swipeor Phantom Pursuit

BLACK CAT.name: FORTUNE'S FAVOR
BLACK CAT.desc: Spend Fortuneto unleash either Grapple Swipeor Phantom Pursuit

BLACK CAT.name: CALLING CARD
BLACK CAT.desc: Issue a Calling Card to all enemies. Instantly dash to any enemy in sight and range, tearing into them with your claws to deal Damage

BLACK CAT.name: CALLING CARD
BLACK CAT.desc: Issue a Calling Card to all enemies. Instantly dash to any enemy in sight and range, tearing into them with your claws to deal Damage

BLACK CAT.name: CAT'S CRADLE
BLACK CAT.desc: Lunge forward with claws bared, slicing through any enemies caught in your path

BLACK CAT.name: CAT'S CRADLE
BLACK CAT.desc: Lunge forward with claws bared, slicing through any enemies caught in your path

BLACK CAT.name: TURN OF FORTUNE
BLACK CAT.desc: Launch a grappling hook forward that damages an enemy on impact and steals Fortunebefore pulling it back to Black Cat

BLACK CAT.name: PHANTOM PURSUIT
BLACK CAT.desc: Swiftly dash to an enemy, unleash a rapid flurry of claw attacks, and flash back to your starting position. Black Cat is Untargetableduring this move

BLACK CAT.name: GILDED DEAL
BLACK CAT.desc: Use the Spatial Resonator to open a portal to the Elder Gods' dimension, consuming Fortune to trade with the Golden Elder and acquire items from the New York Thieves Guild vault.

BLACK CAT.name: TABLET OF DESTINIES
BLACK CAT.desc: Gain a random amount of Fortune

BLACK CAT.name: HELM OF HADES
BLACK CAT.desc: Enter Invisiblestate for a set duration

BLACK CAT.name: FALTINE FLAME ORB
BLACK CAT.desc: Conjure an orb of mystical Faltine Flame to Revealand mark all nearby enemies

BLACK CAT.name: CHERNOBOG'S CRYSTAL
BLACK CAT.desc: Purify yourself, instantly removing any active control effects

BLACK CAT.name: RING OF ZONA
BLACK CAT.desc: Open a portal on a surface, allowing instant traversal to the opposite side

BLACK CAT.name: MENTO-FISH
BLACK CAT.desc: Create a hypnosis field. Inflicts Slow, disables movement abilities, and Groundsall enemies caught within

BLACK CAT.name: THIEVING GRACE
BLACK CAT.desc: Perform a double jump

BLACK CAT.name: STEALTHY CATWALK
BLACK CAT.desc: Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces

BLACK CAT.name: THIEVING GRACE
BLACK CAT.desc: Perform a double jump

BLACK CAT.name: STEALTHY CATWALK
BLACK CAT.desc: Hold {Jump} to crawl up vertical surfaces

BLACK CAT.name: MALKIN MISFORTUNE
BLACK CAT.desc: Apply Jinxto enemies on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a Critical Hit

BLACK CAT.name: GIFT OF GOLD
BLACK CAT.desc: Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting allies speed and healing while dealing damage and slowing enemies. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands shield block range when raised and reflects projectiles back along the crosshair direction.

BLACK CAT.name: MALKIN MISFORTUNE
BLACK CAT.desc: Apply Jinxto enemies on hit. Jinxedfoes have a chance to lose their bonus damage when striking Black Cat with a Critical Hit

BLACK CAT.name: GIFT OF GOLD
BLACK CAT.desc: Black Cat shares items acquired from Insider Trading with White Fox and Captain America. White Fox receives the Life Orb, which restores Spirit Fox Tail energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Radiance that auto-tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting allies speed and healing while dealing damage and slowing enemies. Captain America receives the Vibranium Energy Amplifier, which expands shield block range when raised and reflects projectiles back along the crosshair direction.

BLACK CAT.name: STICKY PAWS
BLACK CAT.desc: Steal a set amount of Fortunewhenever your attacks hit an enemy

BLACK PANTHER.name: Spear Toss
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Toss a Vibranium energy spear forward, creating a Vibranium Force Field and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies in its radius

BLACK PANTHER.name: Bast's Descent
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Summon Bast, pouncing forward, dealing damage, and attaching a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit while refreshing Spirit Rend

BLACK PANTHER.name: Spirit Rend
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Lunge forward and deal damage to enemies. Vibranium Mark produces Bonus Health and refreshes the ability

BLACK PANTHER.name: Spinning Kick
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Spiral forward and attach a Vibranium Mark to enemies hit

BLACK PANTHER.name: Subtle Step
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Hold Space to run on a wall; perform a jump after detaching from the wall

BLACK PANTHER.name: Panther's Cunning
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Deal higher damage when at low Health

BLACK PANTHER.name: GAMMA VIBRANIUM ARMOR
BLACK PANTHER.desc: Hulk charges Namor and Black Panther with gamma radiation. Namor can summon an extra Gamma Monstro which will continuously fire gamma rays at locked-on enemies. The longer the rays hit, the higher the damage. Black Panther's Vibranium armor is enhanced; when his health is low he receives a gamma shield, blocking incoming attacks and becoming Unstoppable

BLADE.name: Ancestral Sword
BLADE.desc: Slash forward with Blade's Ancestral Sword

BLADE.name: Hunter's Shotgun
BLADE.desc: Fire at enemies using your Shotgun

BLADE.name: Scarlet Shroud
BLADE.desc: Parry with Ancestral Sword to become Unstoppable for a brief period, reducing damage taken from the front and decreasing the cooldown of Daywalker Dash

BLADE.name: Thousand-Fold Slash
BLADE.desc: Charge power and swiftly draw the Sword of Dracula, executing a powerful Iaido strike as you dash forward, leaving behind a slashing zone where the sword automatically strikes enemies. Enemies hit suffer Reduced Healing

BLADE.name: Daywalker Dash
BLADE.desc: Dash forward. If wielding your gun, shoot at enemies upon impact, applying a Healing Reduction effect. If wielding your sword, deliver a cleaving strike that inflicts Slow

BLADE.name: Bloodline Awakening
BLADE.desc: Awaken the Dhampir bloodline, enhancing slash speed during continuous attacks and triggering Whirlwind Slash.If all Whirlwind Slash strikes hit, your Attack Speed will further increase. While under this state, you suffer Reduced Healing, but attacks gain Lifesteal

BLADE.name: ECLIPSE EDGE
BLADE.desc: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets

Black Widow.name: Widow's Bite Baton
Black Widow.desc: Strike with the enhanced electric batons

Black Widow.name: Red Room Rifle
Black Widow.desc: Attack with the Red Room Rifle

Black Widow.name: ELECTRO-PLASMA BLAST
Black Widow.desc: Fire an electro-plasma round forward. Upon hitting the environment or an enemy, it explodes and applies a Slow effect

Black Widow.name: ASSASSIN'S FOCUS
Black Widow.desc: Switch the Red Room Rifle to sniper mode. Shots fired in this state pierce through targets and deal increased damage

Black Widow.name: EDGE DANCER
Black Widow.desc: Unleash a spinning kick to Launch Up enemies. Landing the hit will allow her to zip to the target with a grappling hook for a second kick

Black Widow.name: WIDOW'S BITE SLAM
Black Widow.desc: Leap toward a target area and slam the ground with her Widow's Bite gauntlet, dealing damage to enemies within range

Cyclops.name: Optic Blast
Cyclops.desc: Fire a quick burst of kinetic force forward. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate

Cyclops.name: Concussive Beam
Cyclops.desc: Continuously fire a powerful beam that can refract between enemies and the environment. Hitting enemies accelerates Ricochet Force charge rate

Cyclops.name: Ruby Rage
Cyclops.desc: Remove visor and fire a powerful sweeping beam forward. The blast leaves behind volatile excess energy that erupts, dealing massive secondary explosive damage

Cyclops.name: Propulsion Burst
Cyclops.desc: Fire a propulsion beam to push yourself and the target backward, applying a Slow effect to the enemy

Cyclops.name: Ricochet Force
Cyclops.desc: Fire a beam that can diffract and track nearby enemies after hitting terrain. Upon use, Cyclops gains Bonus Health

Cyclops.name: Optic Ascent
Cyclops.desc: Fire a propulsion beam directly downward to push yourself up and knock back hit enemies, applying a Slow effect to them

Cyclops.name: Kinetic Hover
Cyclops.desc: Enter a slow-fall state while firing Concussive Beam mid-air

Cyclops.name: Red Adamantium
Cyclops.desc: Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Bang! Bang! Unleash two hand cannons left and right, because one gun is never enough. Pew pew, baby!

upgrade.name: DUAL DESERT EAGLES - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Keep blasting till you trigger a BOOM. My thoughts literally explode onto the battlefield. Talk about mind-blowing firepower!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Slicey, dicey, twice as nicey! Swing both swords at whoever gets too close. Sushi, anyone?

upgrade.name: KICK@$$ KATANA - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Now with extra chop! Stabs can go straight for the noggin. Heads up! Do a Bunny Hop and POW! Stabby Stabby action guaranteed! Run while you can!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Ever seen someone throw their own face? Watch me KO a crowd, then catch my mug on the rebound!. Don't lose your head over it

upgrade.name: HEADSHOT! - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Juggle my noggin for extra throws! If you catch it thrice, it goes kaboom. Everyone gets a piece of my mind

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Blink, and you'll miss my deadly dash combo. Slash, dash, repeat! Hit someone? You get to go again! (Up to 2 more times. Don't get greedy.) Who says I can't multitask?

upgrade.name: HAZARDOUS HIJINKS - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Now with bouncy castle action! Slash, bounce, repeat. It's like the world's deadliest pinball!. Cooldowns? Never heard of 'em. Keep going as long as you hit stuff, just don't let me fall flat on my ass!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: SKILL ISSUE
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Let's play judge! Pick a dumb-dumb and slap a taunt. They miss an ability? Boom! Gavel drops, and I slap them with pain and snark

upgrade.name: SKILL ISSUE - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Dumbpoochu, I choose you! Taunt time! Their HP melts away, and if they whiff an ability, they get bonus pain AND Vulnerability. Double whammy! Objection? Overruled!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: POP QUIZ!
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Hey, you! Yeah, you! Ready for a challenge? Free speed and healing just for trying. Nail enough hits with the right abilities and unlock the deluxe speed-heal package. It's an A+ in chaos!

upgrade.name: POP QUIZ! - UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Don't just stand there, you blockhead! The challenge's still rolling. But don't worry, I'm not one of those money-hungry scam artists. The buffs are on the house, no price hike. Take on this challenge, and you'll get three freebies: a little Speed boost, Continuous Healing, and Damage Up. Hit enough baddies with the right abilities exactly as I ask, and you unlock the ultimate bundle (Super Speed, Super Healing, Damage Boost AND reset all your cooldowns (except Healing Factor; no cheating!). Now THAT'S love

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: True heroes taunt face-to-face! I roast nearby baddies, mess up their vision, and tank their hits like a boss. Try me!

upgrade.name: DEADPOOL IN YOUR AREA - DUELIST UPGRADED
upgrade.desc: Check out the best trash talk in the Chronoverse! Keep taunting and melting their HP! I even block their screen, so they can't see squat. Plus, I tank hits like a champ. Enemies that stick around too long get the bottom of their screen taped up. By the end, they won't even find their health bar and whatnot. Good luck fighting what you can't see, suckers!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: UPGRADE!
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: I'm here to smack baddies, get XP, and shield my friends! When my XP is full, I get to upgrade an ability! Bonus: Score the final hit and force your foe into a selfie—more XP for me! I'm invincible while striking my best duckface. No photobombs!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: BUNNY HOP
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Hippity-hoppity, Deadpool's on your property! Watch me squeeze in a second jump midair! Hop on heads or kick off walls with Bunny Hop to refresh the cooldown, and if I land on someone? Free health for me, and a headache for them. Whee!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: HEALING FACTOR
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Out of combat? I'm healing up, staying battle-ready to protect my team. And if I'm about to croak? Surprise! I get a free pass, and my health zooms back up. Nice try, villains

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: MAXIMUM FLAIR
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Listen up, eyes on the prize, don't wander off! Every time my abilities land on a bad guy, the style points shoot up a notch! When it's full, I can pop my ultimate! With me on the team, you're all staying alive and fabulous!

DEADPOOL (DUELIST).name: Comical Chaos
DEADPOOL (DUELIST).desc: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie with attitude. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range enjoy a plush-powered healing party!

Daredevil.name: JUSTICE JAB
Daredevil.desc: Swing Billy Clubs forward. Gain Fury on hit

Daredevil.name: RIGHTEOUS CROSS
Daredevil.desc: Cross your Billy Clubs and surge forward. Gain Fury on hit

Daredevil.name: OBJECTION!
Daredevil.desc: Whirl billy clubs in a tight guard to block frontal damage and reflect projectiles, becoming immune to all incoming harm during this stance and gain Fury

Daredevil.name: INFERNAL FURY
Daredevil.desc: Expend Fury to unleash Devil's Chain or Devil's Throw. Devil's Chain converts damage into Bonus Health, while Devil's Throw Slows enemies on hit and temporarily enables Cross Interrogation

Daredevil.name: LET THE DEVIL OUT
Daredevil.desc: Embrace the Beast within. Enemies in Daredevil's line of sight take damage and suffer a ramping Blind effect. Continually gain Fury while active

Daredevil.name: DEVIL'S LATCH
Daredevil.desc: Fire a grappling line that reels Daredevil and his target toward each other. On completion, gain Fury and temporarily enables Cross Interrogation

Daredevil.name: Sonic Pursuit
Daredevil.desc: Locks onto a target, gaining increased Speed; and Damage Reduction when attacked. While in range, dash to the target, Blinding them and restore Fury

Daredevil.name: BLIND ASCENT
Daredevil.desc: Run along walls and spring off them to reposition

Daredevil.name: RADAR SENSE
Daredevil.desc: Detect enemy movements within a set radius

Daredevil.name: BLIND VERDICT
Daredevil.desc: Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

Elsa Bloodstone.name: MONSTER-PIERCER
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Unleash your elephant gun forward. Bullets pierce enemies and deal high damage

Elsa Bloodstone.name: LIVING BULLET
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Fire a Living Bullet round that splits upon impact, seeking nearby enemies and marking each with a Spectral Sigil. Hitting marked targets with Double-Barrel Blaster or Monster-Piercer grants Elsa a brief Speed boost. Living Bullets deal extra damage to shields and enemies with Bonus Health

Elsa Bloodstone.name: BLOODSTONE'S BOOMBOX BULLETS
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range are healed! Elsa Bloodstone's Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. Elsa can recall the rounds to heal based on damage dealt

Elsa Bloodstone.name: APEX PREDATOR
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Summon the Glartrox to charge forward. The Glartrox can be recalled to charge back toward Elsa. When colliding with terrain or upon return, it bites fiercely, dealing heavy damage

Elsa Bloodstone.name: HELIX ADVANCE
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Dash forward. Your next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer

Elsa Bloodstone.name: RUTHLESS PURSUIT
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Dash forward, gaining Bonus Health and launching enemies hit. Follow up with a Double-Barrel Blaster shot that propels you backward and Slows enemies. Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer

Elsa Bloodstone.name: SMOKY SNARE
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Launch a trap containing the monster Diablo. Once deployed, it becomes Invisible and Invulnerable. When an enemy triggers it, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. Use to dash to the trapped enemy. Enemies can destroy Diablo to break free

Elsa Bloodstone.name: INHERITED INSTINCT
Elsa Bloodstone.desc: Dealing damage increases hunting Instinct. Defeating enemies caught by Smoky Snare grants additional Instinct. Higher Instinct reduces the cooldown of Helix Advance

HAWKEYE.name: Hunter's Sight
HAWKEYE.desc: Capture Afterimages of enemies in his view. Damage dealt to an Afterimage is transferred to the corresponding enemy

HAWKEYE.name: Crescent Slash
HAWKEYE.desc: Unsheathe a katana and slash forward, launching up enemies hit

HAWKEYE.name: MOONLIT SLASH
HAWKEYE.desc: Cloak & Dagger inject light and dark energy into Hawkeye's katana. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, enemies hit are launched back, and a blade wave filled with light and energy sweeps forward. This wave passes through both allies and enemies: it heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability

HAWKEYE.name: Hypersonic Arrow
HAWKEYE.desc: Shoot a Hypersonic Arrow, dealing two instances of damage to enemies in its path and inflicting them with Slow. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

HAWKEYE.name: Skyward Leap
HAWKEYE.desc: Perform a double jump in the direction of movement

HAWKEYE.name: Ronin Slash
HAWKEYE.desc: Swing a wakizashi to strike frontal enemies, deflecting all incoming projectiles

HAWKEYE.name: Archer's Focus
HAWKEYE.desc: Aim at an enemy to improve focus, enhancing the damage inflicted by Piercing Arrow

HELA.name: Piercing Night
HELA.desc: Fire multiple Nightsword thorns that detonate after a delay

HELA.name: Goddess of Death
HELA.desc: Soar into the sky and unleash Nastrond Crows from each hand at will

HELA.name: Astral Flock
HELA.desc: Transform into a Nastrond Crow to glide forth, press again to undo the transformation. Gain Bonus Health when the transformation ends

HELA.name: Soul Drainer
HELA.desc: Project an explosive Hel sphere to Stun nearby enemies.

HELA.name: Hel Tendrils
HELA.desc: Venom shares his symbiotes with Jeff and Hela.  Hela's Hel Tendrils unleash a symbiotic Hel Sphere. Upon hit, it pulls nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, slowing enemies that try to escape.

HELA.name: Nastrond Crowstorm
HELA.desc: Defeating an enemy will generate a Nastrond Crow, exploding after a duration

HELA.name: DEATH KNELL
HELA.desc: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing

HUMAN TORCH.name: Blazing Blast
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Launch a fireball to create a Flame Field at the targeted area

HUMAN TORCH.name: Supernova
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Explode with cosmic fire to deal damage to enemies within range. Upon skill activation, all Flame Fields will transform into Flame Tornadoes, dealing extra damage

HUMAN TORCH.name: Plasma Body
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Enter a state of accelerated ascent

HUMAN TORCH.name: Pyro-Prison
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Form a fire wall between Fire Fields to burn enemies

HUMAN TORCH.name: Flaming Meteor
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Dive towards the ground, dealing damage to enemies and detonating any Flame Fields hit

HUMAN TORCH.name: Storm Siblings
HUMAN TORCH.desc: The Invisible Woman taps into her powers, channeling Psionic Might to fortify the entire Fantastic Four team, granting damage resistance. Once activated, they can continually generate Bonus Health, making up for lost Health

HUMAN TORCH.name: Two In One
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage, launching enemies, and creating a zone that disables mobility abilities

HUMAN TORCH.name: Pyrokinetic Energy
HUMAN TORCH.desc: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

IRON FIST.name: Jeet Kune Do
IRON FIST.desc: Strike the targeted enemy with Jeet Kune Do, reducing the cooldown of Block and Strike with every hit

IRON FIST.name: Yat Jee Chung Kuen
IRON FIST.desc: Dash forward to pursue the targeted enemy and unleash a flurry of attacks

IRON FIST.name: Dragon's Defense
IRON FIST.desc: Assume a defensive stance with a boost of Chi to block incoming attacks and gain Damage Reduction, then strike back with Yat Jee Chung Kuen

IRON FIST.name: Living Chi
IRON FIST.desc: Become living Chi to boost his speed, damage, and attack range, delivering stronger punches while reducing the cooldown of Dragon's Defense

IRON FIST.name: K'un-Lun Kick
IRON FIST.desc: Dash forward, delivering a flying kick when hitting an enemy or reaching full range, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Damage increases with lower enemy health

IRON FIST.name: Harmony Recovery
IRON FIST.desc: Cross legs and channel Chi, slowly gaining Bonus Health

IRON FIST.name: Lunar Chi
IRON FIST.desc: Luna Snow grants Winter's Chill to Hawkeye and Iron Fist. When Iron Fist activates Harmony Recovery, he can heal nearby allies with Lunar Chi

IRON FIST.name: Crane Leap
IRON FIST.desc: Perform up to three consecutive jumps while airborne

IRON FIST.name: Chi Absorption
IRON FIST.desc: Assists in taking down enemies allow him to absorb their Chi and gain Bonus Health

IRON MAN.name: Invincible Pulse Cannon
IRON MAN.desc: Fire a devastating pulse cannon in the targeted direction, delivering catastrophic damage to the targeted area upon impact

IRON MAN.name: Hyper-Velocity
IRON MAN.desc: Activate Hyper-Velocity state for swift forward flight

IRON MAN.name: Hyper-Velocity (Armor Overdrive)
IRON MAN.desc: Activate Hyper-Velocity state for swift forward flight

IRON MAN.name: Armor Overdrive
IRON MAN.desc: Activate Armor Overdrive state, enhancing the damage of Repulsor Blast and Unibeam

IRON MAN.name: Micro-Missile Barrage
IRON MAN.desc: When Hyper-Velocity or Armor Overdrive is used, Iron Man can launch a missile bombardment

IRON MAN.name: Micro-Missile Barrage (Armor Overdrive)
IRON MAN.desc: When Hyper-Velocity or Armor Overdrive is used, Iron Man can launch a missile bombardment

IRON MAN.name: NANO TECH
IRON MAN.desc: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

MAGIK.name: Eldritch Whirl
MAGIK.desc: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc

MAGIK.name: Eldritch Whirl
MAGIK.desc: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a Stepping Disc

MAGIK.name: Demon's Rage
MAGIK.desc: Summon a Limbo demon that attacks enemies after exiting a Stepping Disc

MAGIK.name: Demon's Rage
MAGIK.desc: Summon a Limbo demon that attacks enemies after exiting a Stepping Disc

MAGIK.name: Darkchild
MAGIK.desc: Transform into Darkchild, gaining enhancements to all her abilities

MAGIK.name: Stepping Discs
MAGIK.desc: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become Invincible while teleporting

MAGIK.name: Stepping Discs
MAGIK.desc: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become Invincible while teleporting

MAGIK.name: Umbral Incursion
MAGIK.desc: Dash forward and launch up enemies

MAGIK.name: Umbral Incursion
MAGIK.desc: Dash forward and launch up enemies

MAGIK.name: CHAIN OF CYTTORAK
MAGIK.desc: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery with Scarlet Witch and Magik. Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction. Magik can unleash a Chain of Cyttorak that links two enemies and slows them; the farther they are apart, the greater the Slow effect inflicted during the link

MAGIK.name: Limbo's Might
MAGIK.desc: Convert damage inflicted on enemies into Bonus Health to herself

MOON KNIGHT.name: Crescent Dart
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Unleash Crescent Darts forward that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies

MOON KNIGHT.name: Moon Blade
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Launch forward a Moon Blade that can bounce between enemies and Ankhs, dealing damage to enemies

MOON KNIGHT.name: Hand of Khonshu
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Open a portal that allows Khonshu to bombard enemies with his talons

MOON KNIGHT.name: Ancient Ankh
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Fire an Ankh to launch up enemies within its radius towards the center

MOON KNIGHT.name: Moonlight Hook
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Launch a frontal grappling hook that pulls Moon Knight towards it

MOON KNIGHT.name: Triple Eclipse
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Perform a combo with his truncheon, and the third strike will launch up the enemy hit slightly

MOON KNIGHT.name: MOON GOD'S CHOSEN
MOON KNIGHT.desc: Blessed by Khonshu, Blade gains a new ability. When activated, Blade swings his Ancestral Sword in a powerful slash, dashing forward a short distance. At the end of the dash, he swiftly slashes four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets

Mister Fantastic.name: Stretch Punch
Mister Fantastic.desc: Stretch out a forward punch to attack enemies

Mister Fantastic.name: Distended Grip
Mister Fantastic.desc: Extend arms forward to entangle an enemy, then press Primary Attack to pull the hit enemy toward him, or select and yank another enemy, Knocking Them Airborne against each other. Hit targets are Immobilized

Mister Fantastic.name: Brainiac Bounce
Mister Fantastic.desc: Leap upward and smash the ground, slowing enemies within range. Mister Fantastic can leap again upon landing a hit

Mister Fantastic.name: Reflexive Rubber
Mister Fantastic.desc: Stretch the body to absorb damage before launching stored damage in the targeted direction

Mister Fantastic.name: Flexible Elongation
Mister Fantastic.desc: Gain a Shield, select a target and dash towards them, dealing damage to enemies or granting a Shield to allies

Mister Fantastic.name: FANTASTIC AMPLIFIER
Mister Fantastic.desc: Rocket Raccoon upgrades his B.R.B. for Star-Lord and Mister Fantastic. Star-Lord gets an Astral Jump device, allowing him to teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map. Mister Fantastic receives a Fantastic Amplifier, removing his Elasticity limit and letting him actively enter Inflation state

Mister Fantastic.name: Elastic Strength
Mister Fantastic.desc: Using abilities generates Elasticity, boosting attack power. Reaching full Elasticity triggers an Inflated state that increases Maximum Health, further boosts damage, and enables the use of Reflexive Rubber

NAMOR.name: Trident of Neptune
NAMOR.desc: Throw the trident forward, reducing Aquatic Dominion's cooldown upon enemy impact. Critical hits cause Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed

NAMOR.name: Wrath of the Seven Seas
NAMOR.desc: Launch the trident forward to damage nearby enemies, then direct all Monstro Spawn to perform an enhanced attack on the nearest hit enemy. When the trident hits an enemy, Monstro Spawn to enter a berserk state, gaining increased Attack Speed

NAMOR.name: Horn of Proteus
NAMOR.desc: Summon Giganto to leap atop enemies within range, disabling their mobility abilities

NAMOR.name: Blessing of the Deep
NAMOR.desc: Summon a protective barrier while flying upwards

NAMOR.name: Aquatic Dominion
NAMOR.desc: Summon a Monstro Spawn that can autonomously attack enemies

NAMOR.name: TIDAL DIRGE
NAMOR.desc: Hela channels energy of the undead to empower Namor. When Namor strikes with his trident, a spectral water column erupts at the target area, slowing enemies hit. Whenever Hela or Namor assist in a KO, an invulnerable Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position, automatically attacking the nearest foe for a short time before vanishing

PHOENIX.name: Cosmic Flames
PHOENIX.desc: Launch a fiery projectile forward, applying 1 Spark to enemies hit. Critical hits apply 2 Sparks. At 3 Sparks, Phoenix triggers a fiery explosion that applies 1 Spark to enemies around and Healing Over Time to self. Sparks from explosions will not stack within a brief period

PHOENIX.name: Telekinesis Burst
PHOENIX.desc: Mark a targeted area with psionic energy, followed by a series of fiery explosions. The first blast Stuns enemies, while the subsequent two explosions inflict Slow. Applies 1 Spark to enemies hit

PHOENIX.name: Endsong Inferno
PHOENIX.desc: Soar into the sky with the Phoenix and crash down onto a selected area, dealing devastating damage to enemies while creating a shockwave that destroys enemy summons, shields, and any Bonus Health. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark

PHOENIX.name: Telepathic Illusion
PHOENIX.desc: Leave behind an illusion and instantly teleport in the desired direction, followed by detonating the illusion. Enemies hit are applied with 1 Spark

PHOENIX.name: Dark Ascent
PHOENIX.desc: Merge with the Phoenix, entering a state of free flight. Gain a Movement Boost

PHOENIX.name: Mind's Grace
PHOENIX.desc: Jean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force

PSYLOCKE.name: Psionic Crossbow
PSYLOCKE.desc: Unleash bolts with psionic crossbows to damage enemies and reduce the cooldowns of all her abilities

PSYLOCKE.name: Wing Shurikens
PSYLOCKE.desc: Launch a volley of psionic shurikens that stick to enemies, dealing damage and granting herself Bonus Health. Press again to recall the shurikens

PSYLOCKE.name: LIGHT & DARK DARTS
PSYLOCKE.desc: Cloak & Dagger share light and dark energy with Hawkeye and Psylocke. When Hawkeye uses Crescent Slash, he also releases a blade wave that heals and boosts healing for teammates, while inflicting damage and Vulnerability on enemies. Psylocke can launch a Light Boomerang Dart that heals allies, harms enemies, and provides her with temporary healing upon return. She can also unleash a ring of Dark Darts that slow enemies while she briefly enters a Phased state

PSYLOCKE.name: Dance of the Butterfly
PSYLOCKE.desc: Slash nearby enemies with a psionic katana, dealing massive damage

PSYLOCKE.name: Psi-Blade Dash
PSYLOCKE.desc: Dash forward and slice through enemies along the path with psionic blades

PSYLOCKE.name: Psychic Stealth
PSYLOCKE.desc: Enter stealth and gain a Movement Boost

SCARLET WITCH.name: Chaos Control
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Unleash Chaos Magic on enemies to deal damage and restore Chaos Energy

SCARLET WITCH.name: Chthonian Burst
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Consume Chaos Energy to fire explosive magic missiles, damaging enemies

SCARLET WITCH.name: Sorcery Surge
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Doctor Strange shares his arcane mastery, replacing Scarlet Witch's Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst upon activation. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction

SCARLET WITCH.name: Reality Erasure
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Engage in free-flight while charging energy, then unleash it to deal massive damage

SCARLET WITCH.name: Mystic Projection
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Enter the Phased state for free-flight. Press again to exit early

SCARLET WITCH.name: Dark Seal
SCARLET WITCH.desc: Land a hit on a target or the scene, or press E to generate a Force Field that periodically Stuns enemies within range

SPIDER-MAN.name: Spider-Power
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Swing fists forward to strike, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

SPIDER-MAN.name: Web-Cluster
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Shoot a Web-Cluster that deals damage and attaches a Spider-Tracer to the hit enemy

SPIDER-MAN.name: Spectacular Spin
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Launch Web-Clusters all around to damage and Stun enemies

SPIDER-MAN.name: Web-Swing
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Shoot a strand of webbing to swing.

SPIDER-MAN.name: Get Over Here!
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Shoot webbing to reel in the hit enemy. If the enemy is tagged with a Spider-Tracer, Spider-Man will get pulled to them instead

SPIDER-MAN.name: Amazing Combo
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Launch an enemy upward, dealing extra damage to the enemy with a Spider-Tracer

SPIDER-MAN.name: Inferno Blast
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Human Torch stores Pyrokinetic Energy in Spider-Man's suit, enabling him to unleash an Inferno Blast that sprays a fiery web while performing a backflip to create distance. The flames damage enemies and apply a Burn-Tracer. Detonating these Burn-Tracers inflicts Damage Over Time

SPIDER-MAN.name: Sticky Spider-Bomb
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Cyber-Spiders Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging a Web-Cluster shot and granting Bonus Health

SPIDER-MAN.name: Wall Crawl
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Press Space to wall crawl, and while crawling, left-click to sprint

SPIDER-MAN.name: Spider-Sense
SPIDER-MAN.desc: Give a warning of enemies that have been around

SQUIRREL GIRL.name: Squirrel Blockade
SQUIRREL GIRL.desc: Launch an acorn to unleash Squirrel Guards, Imprisoning the first hit enemy

SQUIRREL GIRL.name: Unbeatable Squirrel Tsunami
SQUIRREL GIRL.desc: Summon a horde of squirrels to charge forward, dealing damage while bouncing against structures

SQUIRREL GIRL.name: Tail Bounce
SQUIRREL GIRL.desc: Rocket upwards with a bounce of her tail

SQUIRREL GIRL.name: Mammal Bond
SQUIRREL GIRL.desc: Reload Burst Acorns and can use an ability without cooldown once in a short duration

SQUIRREL GIRL.name: Squirrel Missile
SQUIRREL GIRL.desc: When Iron Man, Ultron and Squirrel Girl team up, Ultron's Encephalo-Ray upgrades to Nano-Ray, firing a beam that pierces through all characters, dealing continuous damage to foes while healing allies; Squirrel Girl gains the Squirrel Missile ability. She directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion!

STAR-LORD.name: Element Guns
STAR-LORD.desc: Shoot enemies with dual Element Guns

STAR-LORD.name: Stellar Shift
STAR-LORD.desc: Dodge in the direction of movement and swiftly reload

STAR-LORD.name: Galactic Legend
STAR-LORD.desc: Engage in free-flight and lock onto enemies in sight

STAR-LORD.name: Rocket Propulsion
STAR-LORD.desc: Consume energy to gain a Movement Boost and soar forward

STAR-LORD.name: Blaster Barrage
STAR-LORD.desc: Fire a frenzy of shots, causing damage to enemies within range.

STAR-LORD.name: Astral Jump
STAR-LORD.desc: Star-Lord gets a teleport to its deployment point from anywhere on the map

STORM.name: Omega Hurricane
STORM.desc: Transform into a hurricane to draw in nearby enemies and deal damage

STORM.name: Weather Control
STORM.desc: Switch the weather to empower allies: Tornado grants a Movement Boost; Thunder grants a Damage Boost

STORM.name: Goddess Boost
STORM.desc: Channel the power of the weather to empower Storm: Tornado grants a Movement Boost and inflicts Slow on enemies; Thunder grants a Damage Boost and summons lightning to inflict damage

STORM.name: ETERNAL WEATHER WITCH
STORM.desc: Storm channels her elemental power into Adam Warlock. When Adam uses Soaring Surge, his movement speed is increased. While flying, Adam leaves behind a storm-charged trail that heals and speeds up allies within it

THE PUNISHER.name: Adjudication
THE PUNISHER.desc: Fire at enemies with Adjudication, his Automatic Rifle

THE PUNISHER.name: Deliverance
THE PUNISHER.desc: Fire at enemies with Deliverance, his Shotgun

THE PUNISHER.name: Scourge Grenade
THE PUNISHER.desc: Throw a smoke grenade forward to obscure enemy vision and leap backward

THE PUNISHER.name: Final Judgement
THE PUNISHER.desc: Unleash two Gatling guns and missiles to attack enemies

THE PUNISHER.name: Vantage Connection
THE PUNISHER.desc: Launch a hook to generate a cable that enables the Punisher to move rapidly by pressing F

THE PUNISHER.name: Culling Turret
THE PUNISHER.desc: Deploy a Culling Turret that grounds Punisher and blocks damage from the front while dealing massive damage

THE PUNISHER.name: JUSTICE SENSE
THE PUNISHER.desc: Daredevil shares the location of his Sonic Pursuit target with The Punisher. At the same time, The Punisher can launch a devil-infused shock grenade to damage and blind enemies

THE PUNISHER.name: Ancient Judgement
THE PUNISHER.desc: The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur, restricting him to only Adjudication/Deliverance and Scourge Grenade while disabling other abilities. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher

THE PUNISHER.name: Warrior's Gaze
THE PUNISHER.desc: Retain vision of enemies that disappear from view for a short duration

THE PUNISHER.name: CUTTING-EDGE TECH
THE PUNISHER.desc: The Punisher upgrades Black Widow's arsenal, adding a Pulse Mode to her Red Room Rifle. While the ability is active, using Straight Shooter fires a pulse beam that deals piercing damage

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Roterstern
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Fire explosive rounds with his blaster, Roterstern, damaging the target hit and enemies behind them.

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Bionic Hook
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Charge up and launch a hook with his bionic arm, reeling in the first target hit and enemies lurking behind

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Kraken Impact
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Leap high, then dash forward and slam down with the bionic arm, dealing damage to enemies in range, marking them for Culling. Marked enemies will perish instantly if their health falls below a certain threshold, recharging the bionic arm for another Kraken Impact within a short period

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Trooper's Fist
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Dash forward, seizing enemies along the path and launching up enemies at the end of the dash

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Tainted Voltage
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Charge up and launch a powerful electrical punch with the bionic arm in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies within range and Slowing them. This ability can Knock Down flying heroes

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Stellar Impact
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to damage nearby foes and grant Bonus Health to allies within range. Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo then collides and unleashes a shockwave that damages and slows enemies

WINTER SOLDIER.name: Ceaseless Charge
WINTER SOLDIER.desc: Roterstern reloads automatically while the bionic arm is in action, granting Bonus Health to the Winter Soldier

Wolverine.name: Savage Claw
Wolverine.desc: Slash with Adamantium claws for a Claw Strike. Unleashing Feral Leap will enhance it to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

Wolverine.name: Vicious Rampage
Wolverine.desc: Dash forward and unleash a Claw Strike

Wolverine.name: Last Stand
Wolverine.desc: Knock enemies ahead airborne and spiral through the air, sweeping up enemies along the path and delivering a devastating impact at the landing point

Wolverine.name: Feral Leap
Wolverine.desc: Leap like an animal to snatch the first enemy upon impact and Smash them to the ground. Unleashing this ability will enhance his normal attack to Berserk Claw Strike for a brief period

Wolverine.name: Phoenix Warrior
Wolverine.desc: Wolverine and Hulk can interact with each other. Once both parties confirm, Hulk can lift Wolverine and press the key to hurl him forwardJean Grey imbues Wolverine with the awe-inspiring Phoenix Force. With this power, Wolverine's Feral Leap transforms into Phoenix Warrior. While active, he is enveloped in Phoenix flames that continuously scorch him and nearby enemies, dealing Percentage Damage. In this state, Wolverine's abilities gain Lifesteal when inflicting damage

Wolverine.name: Undying Animal
Wolverine.desc: Unleash a fierce howl to briefly reduce incoming damage

Wolverine.name: Kinetic Claws
Wolverine.desc: Cyclops supercharges Wolverine's claws, extending his attack range. While active, Wolverine's Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting him a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around him

Wolverine.name: Regenerative Healing Factor
Wolverine.desc: Begin to heal and rise with a hefty Bonus Health, shaking off all debuffs. After a brief moment, any remaining Bonus Health morphs into a one-off heal, zeroing out his Rage. Assists in KOs reduce this cooldown

Wolverine.name: Berserker Rage
Wolverine.desc: Rage builds when Wolverine attacks or takes hits, boosting the damage of his Claw Strikes and the Bonus Health from his regenerative healing factor
